items.caption: The tile is a standalone instance for the visualization (TileVisu) and is separate from the data connection: it reads its values from a TessieVehicle instance and updates immediately when something changes there. If there is exactly one TessieVehicle instance, it is detected automatically as the source – only with several vehicles do you choose the source manually.

The status color (charging/ready/idle) sets the color of the battery bar. The surface, text and font options adapt the tile to your visualization; without a custom setting the tile follows the light/dark design of the device. The tile name can be taken from the vehicle automatically.

With 'Show control buttons' and the 'Buttons' list you freely choose which and how many actions the tile offers – e.g. only lock/unlock, or additionally sentry mode, horn, trunk and windows. You set the order by drag and drop, and each button can have its own label. The buttons trigger the corresponding action variables of the TessieVehicle source – so permissions and behavior are identical to operating them in the object tree. A button only appears if the corresponding data point is enabled there. With the pencil ✎ at the top right of the control area, the same list can also be managed directly in the tile (add, change function/label, order with ▲▼, delete).

With 'Show automations' the tile fully manages the If→Then rules of the TessieVehicle source: '+ New rule' creates a rule, ✎ edits it, the trash can deletes it (with confirmation), the switch activates/deactivates it. In the editor, switchable variables (with an action) are offered as targets – filterable using the search field; for 'Set value' the values defined in the profile/presentation appear as a selection list. The same applies to the 'If' comparison value: if the chosen data point has known values (e.g. seat heater, climate keeper), a selection list appears there instead of free text, and the condition switches automatically from 'becomes ON/OFF' to '=', which makes more sense for multi-valued data points. If the tile is linked in several places, all changes act on the same rules everywhere.

Below that, the tile also manages the locations (geofence): the switch enables the location detection, '+ New location' adds a place (type in coordinates or use the current vehicle position – handy: drive there and save), ✎ edits home and further places, the trash can deletes. For further locations you can additionally choose an icon (suggestions or your own emoji) – it appears in the location list and in the 'Current location' display. The map selection is still available in the instance form; home without coordinates uses the system location.
The button 'Reset colors & font to default' only changes the open form – it is saved only with 'Apply changes'.
